items: Updates: when a new version is out, an "Update" button appears in the overlay's title bar.
The hotkey copies the hovered item and shows it right away, also right after you clicked in the overlay.
New layout: currencies and Omens on the left, the modifier list in the middle, the item preview on the right.
Click a modifier in the list to see it on the item.
The preview shows how many prefix and suffix slots the item has free.
Only currencies and Omens usable on the item are listed.
New icon: the green diamond.

2026-09-29b.heading: 2026-09-29 (update)
items: After copying an item a currency is already chosen: the last one used for this item type, or the Bone without level restrictions.
The Prefix/Suffix filter starts on the side the item has a free slot on.

2026-09-29c.heading: 2026-09-29 (hotkey fix)
items: New default hotkey: Alt+T.
Clicking in the overlay no longer takes focus from the game: hover an item and press the hotkey, no click in the game needed.
Esc works while typing in the search; otherwise the hotkey on the same item or × closes the overlay.

2026-09-29d.heading: 2026-09-29 (speed)
items: Faster item switching after Alt+T.
While copying, the overlay shows a loading state: a dimmed window with the spinning diamond.

2026-09-30.heading: 2026-09-30 (open source)
items: The overlay is now open source under the MIT license: github.com/slapinskiDEV/abyss-craft-overlay-poe2

2026-09-30b.heading: 2026-09-30 (stability)
items: The overlay no longer freezes on some copied items and reacts faster.
If an item cannot be shown, you get a message with "Read clipboard again" and "Copy debug report" instead of an empty window.
If the hotkey is already used by another program, the overlay opens and tells you so.
The tray icon menu has "Reset window position", for a window that ended up off-screen.
Filters no longer get stuck: a new item starts without the previous item's category and level filters.
Unidentified and mirrored items show only the pool for the base, and free slots are not guessed.

2026-09-30c.heading: 2026-09-30 (title bar fix)
items: The × and settings buttons work again, and clicking the title bar no longer freezes the overlay.
Drag the overlay by its title.
The debug report now includes how long the hotkey copy took; please attach it if switching items feels slow.

2026-09-30d.heading: 2026-09-30 (unclickable overlay)
items: Fixed cases where the overlay stopped reacting to clicks after some hotkey presses.
If the overlay ever stops reacting: right-click the tray icon → "Reload overlay".
New in the tray menu: "Open log folder". If something goes wrong, please attach overlay.log from there to your report.

2026-09-30e.heading: 2026-09-30 (hotkey speed)
items: The hotkey no longer fights the game over the clipboard: switching items is faster and the overlay no longer hides because the copy did not arrive.
The overlay stays clickable while an item is being copied.

2026-09-30f.heading: 2026-09-30 (diagnostics)
items: The overlay no longer hides when the game has not finished copying the new item.
More detailed local log (overlay.log) to find why the overlay sometimes stops reacting.
